description: "Drug name lookup" / "find prescription [X]" / "medication autocomplete" / "RxCUI for [drug]" / "what does [pill] treat" / "available strengths for [drug]" — search RxTerms (NLM prescribing-vocabulary derived from RxNorm, ~22k drug names with route/strength). Returns names like "Aspirin (Chewable)", "Lisinopril (Oral Pill)". Use for prescription entry, drug name autocomplete, or as a stepping-stone to RxNorm RxCUI lookups. Pass ef="STRENGTHS_AND_FORMS,RXCUIS" to include dosage strengths and RxNorm IDs.

count.description: Maximum matches to return. Default 7, max 500. Use 1–3 for typeahead UX, 20–50 for browsing.

df.description: Comma-separated display fields to use in the `displays` array. Default varies per table; usually the canonical name.

ef.description: Comma-separated extra fields to include per match. Known fields: STRENGTHS_AND_FORMS,RXCUIS,DISPLAY_NAME_SYNONYM,IS_RETIRED.

terms.description: Search query — prefix/contains match against canonical names. Whitespace-split into AND tokens. Example: "aspirin".

name: drugs
title: Drugs
